gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kanchenjunga: Loud, round and unshaded: Bellota Text makes its headings without any pen-style thick and thin. And Kanchenjunga follows with a drafting-pen line that stays crisp, which suits the heading's bigger, shorter moments.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-koho: Blunt, curvy, and free of stress, Bellota Text takes the lead with confident openness. And KoHo, a sans-serif with wide apertures, fills in underneath without ever competing for attention.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kosugi: Kosugi looks bent from wire, jaws gaping like pliers. Bellota Text is the one that grabs attention with its open, unshaded curves, while Kosugi simply keeps the lines lean and quiet beneath it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kosugi-maru: Kosugi Maru reads like a glowing neon tube, light and rounded. Bellota Text stands above it with open, unshaded curves, and the line below flows along with an easy, steady glow through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-kumbh-sans: Blunt, open and unshaded, Bellota Text announces itself right away, while Kumbh Sans follows with cropped terminals. Shrink the heading and that commanding presence fades fast.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-libre-franklin: Bellota Text has round bowls whose walls never swell or taper, giving headings a stubborn, uniform confidence. And Libre Franklin, with its splayed c terminal, carries a long read in plain sans fashion without any fuss.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-livvic: Livvic reads friendly and unstressed, with a generous c that welcomes the eye. And a stretch of paragraphs beneath Bellota Text would flow along comfortably, never tiring in the plain sans lines.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-m-plus-1: Unshaded, open curves with no calligraphic pen influence make Bellota Text instantly recognizable up top. M PLUS 1 handles the quieter work, its fineliner line and big open eyes doing the reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 brings a gaping c and one fixed nib width to the text. And Bellota Text above it adds a commanding, unshaded voice, which is where this pairing's real strength sits.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Stout and unshaded, Bellota Text leads with confidence. And M PLUS Rounded 1c, its terminals stopping short of curling back, rolls along through paragraphs in a soft plain sans manner.
